 Bomb threat E-mail targets Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow; Mumbai police launch probe
 Mumbai Police have launched an investigation after a bomb threat email allegedly targeting veteran Bollywood actor Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow was reported on Friday. A school in Mumbai’s Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area reportedly received the threatening email. 
 Published By : Pradip Subudhi 
 | October 23, 2026 3:41 PM
 -->
 -->
 Mumbai, October 23:  Mumbai Police have launched an investigation after a bomb threat email allegedly targeting veteran Bollywood actor Amitabh Bachchan’s bungalow was reported on Friday. A school in Mumbai’s Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area reportedly received the threatening email.
 Police are investigating the matter, and further details are awaited. It is yet to be established whether the threat specifically refers to Bachchan’s Jalsa or Prateeksha bungalow in Mumbai.
 In a separate incident, the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) received a threatening email, prompting security checks at its office. According to Mumbai Police, the premises were thoroughly inspected, but no suspicious object or material was found.
 A similar incident was reported on March 20, when the Mumbai Press Club received a threatening email claiming that several small bombs containing poisonous gas had been planted inside the building and would explode at 1 pm.
 According to an official, the email was allegedly sent by an individual identifying themselves as Neeraja Ajmal Khan. The sender claimed that 42 devices containing poisonous gas had been installed inside the Press Club building.
 The email also contained political allegations against the DMK leadership and claimed that supporters from Coimbatore had been misled and subsequently targeted through legal action. The sender alleged that media outlets in Tamil Nadu had blocked attempts to raise the issue.
 The message further claimed that the alleged devices were intended to cause property damage and urged authorities to evacuate the building.
 Police conducted security checks following the threat, and the matter was taken up for investigation. Further details regarding the latest threat email targeting Bachchan’s bungalow are awaited.
